frozen_search_specification.search_field: TITLE_ABS throughout; query terms are lexical report-retrieval proxies, not eligibility/efficacy classification
frozen_search_specification.record_unit: Exact Europe PMC source/id; distinct records are not independently randomized studies

protocol.threshold_policy: If summed counts exceed 150000, preserve counts and assess feasibility explicitly before pagination; no silent truncation or query change. No record cap once a query starts.
protocol.index_drift_policy: Record page hit counts and all duplicate IDs. Report changes/early stop; never declare complete solely from nominal hitCount.
protocol.completion: Reach stable terminal cursor/count, document exact unique count and all pages.

frozen_search_specification.deduplication: Exact (source,id); retain query memberships and all source aliases such as PMID/PMCID/DOI. No merging by title/author/DOI as an independent-study claim.
frozen_search_specification.recall_policy: Known IDs may be queried separately only after discovery counts/pagination, solely for diagnostic metadata; never inserted into discovery queries or used to require direction of outcome. A miss remains a miss. Any discovery revision receives new frozen version retaining v1.
scope_limits: Q2 is intentionally nested within Q3; it supplies an explicit population stratum, not an independent corpus.
Controlled terms are title/abstract proxies. Trials with no selected terminology may be missed; reviews, protocols, preclinical work and non-randomized reports may be included pending review.
The preparation term list is a declared bounded initial vocabulary, not all possible products or compounds.
Muscle mass or biomarkers alone are not accepted as functional endpoints; broad lexical retrieval does not decide eligibility.
No source reading or manual efficacy appraisal credit follows metadata/abstract retrieval.
No efficacy, safety, clinical recommendation, exhaustive enumeration or global-completion inference.
